notes: Table::new with the default preset, to_string. The preset draws a full box with a separator between rows, so output has about twice the lines of the borderless entries. The crate sizes columns itself.
details: Table::new with default preset; to_string of the table. Cells converted to String in the call. The default preset draws a full box with a separator line between every row, so the output has about twice as many lines as the borderless entries; the crate sizes the columns itself from the display width of every cell.
